title: The node panel edits a node's dependencies and bound decisions, and archives it
name: panel-edges
description: `bind` and `archive` have routes and no UI. ADR 0016 rejected drag-to-connect: edges are corrected as a list. Add to the panel a list of what the node depends on and which decisions it binds, each removable, with a picker to add one — saving sends the full lists, because `bind` replaces. Show the cycle refusal the server returns as its own message. Add an archive action behind a confirmation. Delete bind and archive from KNOWN_GAPS.
